question: Which plane ring graphs have every count of returns even, and, when every ring has the same size (so rings with different numbers of contacts cannot be uniform), can a figure-eight or a chord across a loop cancel every return some other way?

public_inputs.library: loopnet_lib.py of LOOP-NET-20261108-001A (sha256 1adbc514bf5aaf3b23af55229a9b9d1a7795f3a0f9a3312bf2f86cf75920197b), on SEPARATE-20261108-001A's net_lib.
public_inputs.run: run.py in this folder, 16 worker processes.
public_inputs.family: Part 1: networkx's graph atlas, graphs of 2 to 7 vertices that are connected, planar and of minimum degree 2 (395), each with networkx's plane rotation and equally spaced contacts. Part 2: figure-eights of loops of (2, 2), (2, 3) and (3, 3) rings, chords (1, 1, 2) and (1, 2, 2), and the theta (2, 2, 2), every ring of s = 5 to 9 cells, every cyclic order on rings of three or more contacts and every spacing with gaps of at least two cells: 170,502 networks.
public_inputs.exactness: D is computed exactly over GF(2)(z); return counts by powers of the arc matrix mod 2 until they repeat; rows of M^T exactly to lag 300. Persistence beyond lag 300 is not decided here.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the families after seeing results
primary_observable: Part 2: placements with no pair of equal parallel corners whose returns all cancel (H1 predicts none), and placements that persist to lag 300 anyway. Part 1: graphs with a flip at every contact whose return counts are not all even (H2 predicts none), and graphs whose return counts are all even without a flip at every contact.
cheapest_meaningful_control: LOOP-NET-20261108-001A's checks 1, 3 and 4 (the exact D against the cell reading and against return counts).
decision_or_followup_rule: H1 and H2, frozen. If H1 holds, it supports the obstruction beyond uniform networks for these families at equal ring sizes; a non-degenerate placement cancelling every return would be recorded as a second mechanism. H2 is a check of LOOP-NET-20261108-001A's Theorem 3; a failure would withdraw it.
stop_rule: Stop when every network of both parts has its verdict.
nonclaims: Exploratory: lags to 300, sizes 5 to 9, these families, one plane rotation per atlas graph.
feasibility_disclosure: Before freezing: scratch surveys of the figure-eight (2, 2) and the chords (1, 1, 2) and (1, 2, 2) at equal ring sizes up to 9 found no placement without a cancelled corner pair whose returns all cancel; a scan of the same 395 atlas graphs found 8 with every return count even, 7 of them with a flip at every contact. So H1 and H2 are not blind predictions. run.py --pilot timed 352 sampled networks at 0.6 s and printed no verdicts.
